ambiguityScan.justification: AC 4 ('opening a ticket and returning to the Tickets page restores the previous list state') admitted two honest readings of 'returning': (A) any navigation back to /tickets restores the state, requiring the global nav Tickets link (client/src/components/Layout.tsx:52) to carry preserved state and therefore a store of the last list URL outside the URL itself; (B) only retracing the path back — browser Back, or the ticket-detail back link (client/src/pages/TicketDetailPage.tsx:27) — restores it, while the global nav link keeps meaning 'fresh default list'. JB Mccallaghan resolved this to reading B at the spec gate on 2026-09-05. Reading B keeps the URL as the single source of truth, which is the story's own stated premise; reading A would have reintroduced non-URL list state. Layout.tsx:52 is therefore explicitly out of scope and the nav link continues to land on a clean /tickets.

e2e.note: First actual execution. Full suite run three times: 82/82 every time (4.3m, 2.4m, 3.9m); the 13 new scenarios 13/13. The third run was at this checks.commit; the first two were at 093cef0, whose tree differs only in .solvo and docs markdown (git diff --stat 093cef0..1174a2c touches no source or test file). This replaces an 'n/a' record that named the database credential as the sole blocker - it was not. playwright.config.ts started the client webServer with a POSIX 'VITE_API_URL=... bun run' prefix, and Playwright spawns webServer through the platform shell, so cmd.exe read VITE_API_URL as a program name and the suite could not start on Windows at all. Present since initial commit 65da45b and on main; this branch had never touched the file. Fixed via the webServer env field. Two further defects found by running them: CASE-6e5a5e6f195f failed 6 runs in 10 (a page.route pattern broad enough to park goBack()'s own request, then unroute racing the parked handlers into 'Route is already handled!') - now matched on sortBy=subject, 10/10, and non-vacuity confirmed by inverting the expected row order; and this story's 8 tests x 11 seeded tickets pushed tickets.spec.ts's and ticket-detail.spec.ts's own tickets off page 1 of an unfiltered list under fullyParallel, so workers:1 is now set. Attribution measured, not inferred: 69/69 in parallel with the new spec excluded, 3 failures with it included, both pre-existing specs green at --workers=1. Caveat on the evidence: OPENAI_API_KEY is unset here, so auto-resolve-ticket throws and the recorded seed race never fired - it is untested rather than disproven.
